## Compatibility and data

## Checklist

- [ ] The title, description, identifiers, and documentation follow the English conventions in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] I documented relevant validation results above and updated tests/docs where needed.
- [ ] The change preserves existing user data, or its migration is documented and verified.
- [ ] No credentials or private data are included, and applicable license/attribution notices are preserved.
